findings: getAllStudents error handling breaks MVC pattern — The controller has an internal try-catch that returns 500 with 'Failed to fetch students', bypassing the global errorHandler. This breaks centralized error handling and means errors inside this block won't be classified correctly (ValidationError, CastError, etc. all become 500). Remove the try-catch and let asyncHandler + errorHandler handle errors like the other four controllers do.

Logger utility created but unused — utils/logger.js exports info/warn/error functions with timestamp formatting, but no file imports it. The codebase still uses console.log/console.error directly. Either integrate the logger or remove it.
